status: frozen before any A4a outcome generation
scope: Fresh causal component test of whether assigning identical frozen prestate content to different conversational roles/turns changes transition behavior. A4a decomposes the A3 interface-form effect at the shallowest representational boundary; it does not change semantic content, test normative quality, or introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: randomized interface-form bundle test returned CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a_object: isolate conversational role/turn topology while holding canonical lexical, numerical, ordering, formatting, instructional, and semantic content fixed

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, and any A4a plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A4a cohort

canonical_content.state_chunk:
PREVIOUS STATE:
ANSWER: <exact frozen initial answer>
P_CORRECT: <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals>
canonical_content.signal_chunk:
SIGNAL:
<exact frozen A4a E0 or EV signal text>
canonical_content.identity_rule: For a given frozen prestate and signal condition, concatenating all non-prefill message contents with exactly two newline characters must reconstruct the identical canonical_text under K_inline and K_history. Only role labels and turn boundaries may differ.

topology.K_inline: one user message contains canonical_text in full
topology.K_history: user question_chunk; assistant state_chunk; user signal_chunk plus revision_chunk; then common answer prefill
topology.causal_object: assignment of identical canonical state content to user/assistant roles and turn boundaries

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_revision_instruction:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create eight branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the four cell labels within block with exact 2/2/2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a4a::' + branch_id); topology and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different role/turn tokenizations need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within a topology arm's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within a topology arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within a topology arm's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within a topology arm, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and not a primary endpoint

secondary_estimands.Q_N_topology_difference: Q_N(K_history) - Q_N(K_inline), inferentially reported only if each topology arm has at least 20 neutral revision events
secondary_estimands.G_verified_minus_neutral_by_topology: same within-topology EV-minus-E0 final-correction contrast; transition-specific only and never a representation indicator

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_randomization_tests: For Delta_K_change and Delta_K_instability, shuffle K_inline/K_history labels only among the four E0 branches within each block preserving 2/2. For Delta_K_verified, shuffle K_inline/K_history labels only among the four EV branches within each block preserving 2/2. Recompute block-level endpoints after every shuffle.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided blocked-randomization p-values; these are the only primary p-values.
analysis.effect_intervals: 95% whole-block bootstrap intervals for each primary block-level mean contrast
analysis.Q_N_analysis: If both topology arms meet the revision-event threshold, report pooled Q_N difference with a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; otherwise mark not adjudicable. Q_N does not enter the primary multiplicity family or A4a summary gate.
analysis.secondary_interaction: Report Gamma_KE point estimate and 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; no secondary interaction p-value and no construct interpretation.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_CONVERSATIONAL_TOPOLOGY_SIGNAL: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal and their signs/magnitudes.
decision_gate.CONVERSATIONAL_TOPOLOGY_WEAKENED_AT_A2_S: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]. This weakens role/turn topology as the A3 active component at the inherited A2 practical scale; it does not invalidate A3.
decision_gate.A4A_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions move together.

interpretation_guardrails: A4a tests conversational role/turn topology only; it does not test which topology is normatively better.
Only role assignment and turn boundaries may differ. Any lexical, numerical, ordering, formatting, instructional, or semantic content difference invalidates the intended manipulation.
A causal effect on one transition dimension does not imply effects on the others.
A null primary p-value alone does not weaken the component explanation; the frozen practical-equivalence gate is additionally required.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and cannot be inferred when revision events are insufficient.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.
Gamma_KE is a secondary factorial interaction, not a latent trait or new construct.
G_verified_minus_neutral is transition-specific and never a representation indicator.
A4a does not alter answer information, P_CORRECT availability, signal semantics, or revision instructions.
A4a does not test verbatim historical wording versus canonical wording; that is downstream only if role/turn topology is weakened or further localization is needed.
No A4a result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
